entries.title: Create a manual save
entries.summary: Create a manual save before the first long exploration or equipment-investment session.

entries.title: Make a Private Storage deposit
entries.summary: Deposit overflow, duplicate equipment or reserve materials before continuing a long route.

entries.title: Acquire a skill through Watch and Learn
entries.summary: Use the Watch and Learn system, then test the acquired skill under repeatable conditions.

entries.title: Reveal a region from a bell tower
entries.summary: Use a city bell tower to reveal regional map information and nearby points of interest.

entries.title: Activate an Abyss Nexus
entries.summary: Identify and activate an Abyss Nexus to extend the usable fast-travel network.

entries.title: Investigate Mysterious Energy
entries.summary: Investigate a Mysterious Energy location and determine whether it contains travel or puzzle value.

entries.title: Complete the Hernand arrival circuit
entries.summary: Check map information, travel access, storage, smithy, saddlery, shops and local requests before leaving Hernand.

entries.title: Inspect Hernand's Wolf Saddle stock
entries.summary: Confirm the Wolf Saddle offering at Hernand's saddlery.

entries.title: Inspect Hernand's Bear Saddle stock
entries.summary: Confirm the Bear Saddle offering at Hernand's saddlery.

entries.title: Register a special mount
entries.summary: Gain an eligible animal's trust and complete its registration as a special mount.

entries.title: Equip a special-mount saddle
entries.summary: Purchase and equip a saddle compatible with a registered special mount.

entries.title: Register a Baby Wyvern
entries.summary: Register a Baby Wyvern after the relevant special-mount support becomes available.

entries.title: Register a Kuku Bird Chick
entries.summary: Register a Kuku Bird Chick as a supported special mount.

entries.title: Gain access to Blackstar
entries.summary: Record access to the spoiler-controlled legendary aerial traversal mount.

entries.title: Complete a controlled refinement
entries.summary: Refine an item after saving, recording the inputs and deciding a stopping point in advance.

entries.title: Extract refinement materials
entries.summary: Use extraction and confirm the item remains while refinement materials are returned according to the documented recovery rules.

entries.title: Socket an Abyss Gear item
entries.summary: Place a supported Abyss Gear item into an equipment socket and verify the resulting loadout state.

entries.title: Obtain Ranged Weapons of the World — Bows, Vol. I
entries.summary: Obtain the book added to Hernand's Equipment Shop in Patch 1.11.00.
